% Adapted from the TeX Live 2025 pgfgantt progress examples.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfgantt}
\begin{document}
\begin{ganttchart}[
  x unit=0.5cm,
  y unit title=0.55cm,
  y unit chart=0.7cm,
  hgrid,
  vgrid,
  bar/.append style={fill=green!55},
  bar incomplete/.append style={fill=red!45}
]{1}{10}
  \gantttitle{Progress}{10} \\
  \ganttbar[progress=100]{Completed}{1}{4} \\
  \ganttbar[progress=37]{In progress}{3}{8} \\
  \ganttbar[progress=0]{Queued}{7}{10}
\end{ganttchart}
\end{document}
